rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Booleans take xbox_joins: the box immediately left of the printed option. Part III items 16-24 pair the 11-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). Part IV: the layout keys are numbered 24-27 and print as items 25-28; they are matched to the printed rows by their captions (Cash/Bank Debit Memo, Check, Tax Debit Memo, Others) and their Drawee Bank/Number/Amount columns. Schedule 1A/1B: each printed ATC code row (XG021 to XG120, plus the two Others rows) maps its five cells in print order to Exempt1, Taxable1, Exempt2, Taxable2, TaxDue; the Others rows also take the name and tax-rate cells. Region/province/city keys and lstSpecialTax hold option codes (default 00 or a code), not printable text, and stay blank. The second address line has no layout key and stays blank. Items 10 and 11 print the region, province and city names from derived:line: keys of to_print_field_map (the upload keeps the codes); a derived:line: value or an email wider than its comb prints whole on one line across the comb. date_joins split each payment-row date (MM/DD/YYYY) across the MM, DD and YYYY combs of the row whose Agency/Number/Amount joins share its suffix.
